hardware.source: Owner confirmed this MacBook ran the campaign; sysctl hardware queried during submission preparation.

training_interval_scope: First to last timestamp in each of the 520 local logs/run.log files; excludes initialization before the first log, post-training evaluation, paired contrasts and reporting. Local logs are not distributed.

planning_estimates.basis: 320-run pipeline took 3.087 hours. Scaling to 520 runs gives 5.02 hours; allow overhead for forecasts, calibration, reporting and scheduling. Estimate, not a measured full-campaign rerun.
